p0.original: When the German and Scythian nations overran the western provinces of the Roman empire, the confusions which followed so great a revolution lasted for several centuries. The rapine and violence which the barbarians exercised against the ancient inhabitants, interrupted the commerce between the towns and the country. The towns were deserted, and the country was left uncultivated; and the western provinces of Europe, which had enjoyed a considerable degree of opulence under the Roman empire, sunk into the lowest state of poverty and barbarism. During the continuance of those confusions, the chiefs and principal leaders of those nations acquired, or usurped to themselves, the greater part of the lands of those countries. A great part of them was uncultivated; but no part of them, whether cultivated or uncultivated, was left without a proprietor. All of them were engrossed, and the greater part by a few great proprietors.
p0.zh: 当德意志和西西支诸国征服罗马帝国的西部省份时,继如此伟大的革命之后的混乱持续了几个世纪.野蛮人对古代居民的说唱和暴力,打断了城镇和国家的商业活动。诸城荒废,国家未开垦;罗马帝国统治下的欧洲西部省份相当富饶,陷入了最底层的贫困和野蛮状态. 在继续这些混乱期间,这些国家的酋长和主要领导人获得或篡夺了这些国家大部分的土地。其一大部分未开垦;但其中无论种植还是未开垦,都没有留下任何一部分没有地主. 他们全都被包围了, 更多的是几个伟大的业主。

p1.original: This original engrossing of uncultivated lands, though a great, might have been but a transitory evil. They might soon have been divided again, and broke into small parcels, either by succession or by alienation. The law of primogeniture hindered them from being divided by succession; the introduction of entails prevented their being broke into small parcels by alienation.
p1.zh: 这种原始的未开垦土地的占地,虽然是一个伟大的,但可能只是一个过渡性的邪恶. 他们可能很快又被瓜分,并被分成小块,要么通过继承,要么通过疏远.长子法阻止了他们因继承而分裂;引入后,就防止他们因异化而成为小块地。

p2.original: When land, like moveables, is considered as the means only of subsistence and enjoyment, the natural law of succession divides it, like them, among all the children of the family; of all of whom the subsistence and enjoyment may be supposed equally dear to the father. This natural law of succession, accordingly, took place among the Romans who made no more distinction between elder and younger, between male and female, in the inheritance of lands, than we do in the distribution of moveables. But when land was considered as the means, not of subsistence merely, but of power and protection, it was thought better that it should descend undivided to one. In those disorderly times, every great landlord was a sort of petty prince. His tenants were his subjects. He was their judge, and in some respects their legislator in peace and their leader in war. He made war according to his own discretion, frequently against his neighbours, and sometimes against his sovereign. The security of a landed estate, therefore, the protection which its owner could afford to those who dwelt on it, depended upon its greatness. To divide it was to ruin it, and to expose every part of it to be oppressed and swallowed up by the incursions of its neighbours. The law of primogeniture, therefore, came to take place, not immediately indeed, but in process of time, in the succession of landed estates, for the same reason that it has generally taken place in that of monarchies, though not always at their first institution. That the power, and consequently the security of the monarchy, may not be weakened by division, it must descend entire to one of the children. To which of them so important a preference shall be given, must be determined by some general rule, founded not upon the doubtful distinctions of personal merit, but upon some plain and evident difference which can admit of no dispute. Among the children of the same family there can be no indisputable difference but that of sex, and that of age. The male sex is universally preferred to the female; and when all other things are equal, the elder everywhere takes place of the younger. Hence the origin of the right of primogeniture, and of what is called lineal succession.
p2.zh: 当土地与可移动土地一样,被视为仅能维持生计和享受的手段时,继承的自然法则将土地与家庭所有子女一样分割开来;对于所有子女来说,其维持生计和享受可以被认为对父亲同样珍视。 因此,这种自然继承法发生在罗马人之间,他们在土地继承方面对年长者和年幼者、男女之间的区别,比我们在可移动物分配方面所作的区别更大。 但是,当土地不仅被视为生存的手段,而且被视为权力和保护的手段时,人们更认为,土地应当被分割成一种。 在那些混乱的时代,每个伟大的房东都是小王子 他的房客是他的臣民。 他是他们的法官,在某些方面,他们是和平的立法者和战争领导人。 他根据自己的酌处权发动战争,经常针对他的邻居,有时甚至针对他的君主. 因此,地产的安全,其所有者所能向居住于地产的人提供的保护,取决于其伟大性。瓜分它就是破坏它,并暴露它的每一部分被其邻国的入侵压迫和吞噬。 因此,长子法的出现,不是立即的,而是在时间的进程中,在地产的继承中,同样的原因,一般都发生在君主制的体裁中,虽然并不总是在他们的第一体制中.权力,因此君主制的安全,不可因分裂而削弱,必须全部降为子嗣之一. 其中哪一项如此重要,必须根据某些一般规则来确定,该规则的基础不是可疑的个人功绩区别,而是一些不容争议的明显和明显的差别。在同一家庭的子女中,除了性别和年龄之外,没有无可争辩的区别。男性的性别普遍比女性更受青睐;当所有其他事情都平等时,各地的长者都发生在年轻人身上. 因此,长子继承权以及所谓的继承权的起源。

p3.original: Laws frequently continue in force long after the circumstances which first gave occasion to them, and which could alone render them reasonable, are no more. In the present state of Europe, the proprietor of a single acre of land is as perfectly secure in his possession as the proprietor of 100,000. The right of primogeniture, however, still continues to be respected; and as of all institutions it is the fittest to support the pride of family distinctions, it is still likely to endure for many centuries. In every other respect, nothing can be more contrary to the real interest of a numerous family, than a right which, in order to enrich one, beggars all the rest of the children.
p3.zh: 法律往往在第一次出现这种情况之后很久才继续有效,而只有这种情况才能使其合理。 在目前欧洲的状态下,一亩土地的拥有者与10万土地的拥有者一样完全安全。 然而,长子化的权利仍然受到尊重;由于所有机构最适于支持家庭的尊崇,它仍然有可能持续许多世纪。 在任何其他方面,最违背众多家庭实际利益的权利莫过于为养活一个家庭而乞讨所有其余儿童的权利。

p4.original: Entails are the natural consequences of the law of primogeniture. They were introduced to preserve a certain lineal succession, of which the law of primogeniture first gave the idea, and to hinder any part of the original estate from being carried out of the proposed line, either by gift, or device, or alienation; either by the folly, or by the misfortune of any of its successive owners. They were altogether unknown to the Romans. Neither their substitutions, nor fidei commisses, bear any resemblance to entails, though some French lawyers have thought proper to dress the modern institution in the language and garb of those ancient ones.
p4.zh: 尾部是长子纪律的自然后果.引入它们是为了保留一定的线性继承,其中长子法首先给出了这个想法,并为了阻止原产业的任何部分通过赠与,或装置,或疏远,或是由于愚昧,或是由于其任何后继所有者的不幸而实施拟议的线性继承.罗马人根本不知道他们是谁 他们的替代物或finei commisses 都没有任何相似之处,尽管一些法国律师认为应该用这些古老的语气和服装给现代机构穿好衣服。

p5.original: When great landed estates were a sort of principalities, entails might not be unreasonable. Like what are called the fundamental laws of some monarchies, they might frequently hinder the security of thousands from being endangered by the caprice or extravagance of one man. But in the present state of Europe, when small as well as great estates derive their security from the laws of their country, nothing can be more completely absurd. They are founded upon the most absurd of all suppositions, the supposition that every successive generation of men have not an equal right to the earth, and to all that it possesses; but that the property of the present generation should be restrained and regulated according to the fancy of those who died, perhaps five hundred years ago. Entails, however, are still respected, through the greater part of Europe; In those countries, particularly, in which noble birth is a necessary qualification for the enjoyment either of civil or military honours. Entails are thought necessary for maintaining this exclusive privilege of the nobility to the great offices and honours of their country; and that order having usurped one unjust advantage over the rest of their fellow-citizens, lest their poverty should render it ridiculous, it is thought reasonable that they should have another. The common law of England, indeed, is said to abhor perpetuities, and they are accordingly more restricted there than in any other European monarchy; though even England is not altogether without them. In Scotland, more than one fifth, perhaps more than one third part of the whole lands in the country, are at present supposed to be under strict entail.
p5.zh: 当大地产是某种主要财产时,所涉问题可能并非不合理。与一些君主制国家所谓的根本法一样,它们可能经常阻碍成千上万人的安全,使其不会因一个人的淫荡或奢侈而受到威胁。 但是,在欧洲的目前状况下,当小的和伟大的庄园从其国家的法律中获得安全时,没有什么比这更完全荒谬的了。 它们建立在最荒谬的假设之上,这种假设是,每一代人对地球和对地球拥有的一切没有平等的权利;但是,现在这一代人的财产应当根据那些可能五百年前死去的人的幻想加以约束和管理。 但是,由于欧洲大部分地区,尾声仍然得到尊重; 在这些国家,特别是贵族出身是享受民事或军事荣誉的必要条件。人们认为,为了保持贵族对本国重要职务和荣誉的这一专属特权,必须提供细节;而且,如果命令篡夺了一个不公正的优势,而不是剥夺其他同胞的利益,那么,他们应该拥有另一个特权,这被认为是合理的。 的确,英格兰的普通法被说成是永久的,因此,与任何其他欧洲君主制国家相比,英格兰受到的限制更大;尽管即使英格兰也并非完全没有它们。 在苏格兰,目前全国土地的五分之一以上,也许三分之一以上,理应严格分配。

p6.original: Great tracts of uncultivated land were in this manner not only engrossed by particular families, but the possibility of their being divided again was as much as possible precluded for ever. It seldom happens, however, that a great proprietor is a great improver. In the disorderly times which gave birth to those barbarous institutions, the great proprietor was sufficiently employed in defending his own territories, or in extending his jurisdiction and authority over those of his neighbours. He had no leisure to attend to the cultivation and improvement of land. When the establishment of law and order afforded him this leisure, he often wanted the inclination, and almost always the requisite abilities. If the expense of his house and person either equalled or exceeded his revenue, as it did very frequently, he had no stock to employ in this manner. If he was an economist, he generally found it more profitable to employ his annual savings in new purchases than in the improvement of his old estate. To improve land with profit, like all other commercial projects, requires an exact attention to small savings and small gains, of which a man born to a great fortune, even though naturally frugal, is very seldom capable. The situation of such a person naturally disposes him to attend rather to ornament, which pleases his fancy, than to profit, for which he has so little occasion. The elegance of his dress, of his equipage, of his house and household furniture, are objects which, from his infancy, he has been accustomed to have some anxiety about. The turn of mind which this habit naturally forms, follows him when he comes to think of the improvement of land. He embellishes, perhaps, four or five hundred acres in the neighbourhood of his house, at ten times the expense which the land is worth after all his improvements; and finds, that if he was to improve his whole estate in the same manner, and he has little taste for any other, he would be a bankrupt before he had finished the tenth part of it. There still remain, in both parts of the united kingdom, some great estates which have continued, without interruption, in the hands of the same family since the times of feudal anarchy. Compare the present condition of those estates with the possessions of the small proprietors in their neighbourhood, and you will require no other argument to convince you how unfavourable such extensive property is to improvement.
p6.zh: 如此一来,大片未开垦的土地不仅被某些家庭所占据,而且他们再次被瓜分的可能性也尽可能地被永远排除。 然而,一个伟大的业主很少会是一个大改进者。 在造成这些野蛮体制的无序时期,大业主被充分雇用来保卫自己的领土,或将其管辖权和权力扩大到邻国的领土。 他没有闲暇时间去照顾土地的耕种和改善. 当法律和秩序的建立给他这种闲暇时间时,他常常想要这种倾向,而且几乎总是必要的能力. 如果像经常那样,他的房屋和人员的费用等于或超过他的收入,他就没有股票可以以这种方式雇用。 如果他是经济学家,他一般认为用他每年的积蓄进行新购买比用他旧庄园的改良更有利可图.与所有其他商业项目一样,改善有利润的土地,需要确切地注意小额储蓄和小额收益,其中,一个天生财富丰厚的人,即使自然节俭,也很少有能力. 这种人的情况自然使他不得不去参加装饰,这令他喜欢,而不是牟利,他几乎没有机会去参加。 他的衣着、装备、房屋和家庭家具的优雅,从婴儿时期起,他就习惯于有些焦虑。 这种习惯自然形成的思维转变,在他想到土地的改善时,跟随他. 他也许在住宅的附近装饰了四五百英亩的土地,花费十倍于他所有改良后的土地的价值;并且发现,如果他要以同样的方式改善他的全部庄园,而他对于其他的品味也很少,那么他在完成第十部分之前就已经破产了. 在统一王国的两部分,仍然存在一些大庄园,这些庄园自封建无政府时代以来一直不间断地持续在同一个家族的手中.把这些地产的现状与小业主在他们邻里的财产相比较,你不需要任何其他理由来说服你,这种广泛的地产对于改善是多么不利。

p7.original: If little improvement was to be expected from such great proprietors, still less was to be hoped for from those who occupied the land under them. In the ancient state of Europe, the occupiers of land were all tenants at will. They were all, or almost all, slaves, but their slavery was of a milder kind than that known among the ancient Greeks and Romans, or even in our West Indian colonies. They were supposed to belong more directly to the land than to their master. They could, therefore, be sold with it, but not separately. They could marry, provided it was with the consent of their master; and he could not afterwards dissolve the marriage by selling the man and wife to different persons. If he maimed or murdered any of them, he was liable to some penalty, though generally but to a small one. They were not, however, capable of acquiring property. Whatever they acquired was acquired to their master, and he could take it from them at pleasure. Whatever cultivation and improvement could be carried on by means of such slaves, was properly carried on by their master. It was at his expense. The seed, the cattle, and the instruments of husbandry, were all his. It was for his benefit. Such slaves could acquire nothing but their daily maintenance. It was properly the proprietor himself, therefore, that in this case occupied his own lands, and cultivated them by his own bondmen. This species of slavery still subsists in Russia, Poland, Hungary, Bohemia, Moravia, and other parts of Germany. It is only in the western and south-western provinces of Europe that it has gradually been abolished altogether.
p7.zh: 如果期望这些大业主能够取得什么改善,那么,那些占领他们土地的人就更不希望取得什么改善。在欧洲古代国家,土地的占有者都是随意租户. 他们都是奴隶,或几乎都是奴隶,但他们的奴隶制比古希腊人和罗马人所知的要温和,甚至在我们西印度殖民地中也一样. 他们应该更直接地归属于土地,而不是主人。 因此,它们可以随同出售,但不能分开出售。 他们可以结婚,但须经主人同意;此后,他不能通过将夫妻卖给不同的人来解除婚姻。 如果他残害或谋杀其中任何一人,他应受到一些惩罚,尽管一般情况下,但受到一些小惩罚。 但是,他们没有能力获得财产。 他们所获得的一切,都是他们的主所获得,他可以随意地从他们那里夺取.任何种植和改善都可以由这些奴隶的主人进行。 这是他的钱。种子、牛和畜牧工具都是他的。 这是为了他的利益。 这种奴隶只能得到日常的维持。 因此,正是业主自己占领了自己的土地,由自己的仆人耕种。 这种奴隶制物种在俄罗斯,波兰,匈牙利,波希米亚,摩拉维亚,德国其他地区仍然存在. 只有在欧洲西部和西南部省份,它才被逐渐完全废除.

p8.original: But if great improvements are seldom to be expected from great proprietors, they are least of all to be expected when they employ slaves for their workmen. The experience of all ages and nations, I believe, demonstrates that the work done by slaves, though it appears to cost only their maintenance, is in the end the dearest of any. A person who can acquire no property can have no other interest but to eat as much and to labour as little as possible. Whatever work he does beyond what is sufficient to purchase his own maintenance, can be squeezed out of him by violence only, and not by any interest of his own. In ancient Italy, how much the cultivation of corn degenerated, how unprofitable it became to the master, when it fell under the management of slaves, is remarked both by Pliny and Columella. In the time of Aristotle, it had not been much better in ancient Greece. Speaking of the ideal republic described in the laws of Plato, to maintain 5000 idle men (the number of warriors supposed necessary for its defence), together with their women and servants, would require, he says, a territory of boundless extent and fertility, like the plains of Babylon.
p8.zh: 但是,如果人们很少期望大业主能作出重大改进,那么当他们为工人雇用奴隶时,他们就最不可能指望得到这些改善。 我认为,所有年龄和国家的经验都表明,奴隶所做的工作尽管似乎只花费他们的维持费,但最终却是最宝贵的。 一个不能获得任何财产的人,除了吃得尽可能多的东西和尽可能少地劳动之外,没有其他利益. 无论他做什么工作,除了足以购买自己的赡养费外,只能通过暴力,而不是出于他自己的利益,来挤出他。 在古意大利,玉米的种植堕落了多少,它变得如何无利可图,当它落入奴隶的管理之下时,普林尼和科卢梅拉都曾提到过. 在亚里士多德时代,在古希腊并没有比这好很多.说到柏拉图法律中描述的理想共和国,即保持5000名闲散的男性(其防卫所必须的战士数量),加上她们的妇女和仆人,他说,需要像巴比伦平原一样,拥有无限的面积和生育力的领土.

p9.original: The pride of man makes him love to domineer, and nothing mortifies him so much as to be obliged to condescend to persuade his inferiors. Wherever the law allows it, and the nature of the work can afford it, therefore, he will generally prefer the service of slaves to that of freemen. The planting of sugar and tobacco can afford the expense of slave cultivation. The raising of corn, it seems, in the present times, cannot. In the English colonies, of which the principal produce is corn, the far greater part of the work is done by freemen. The late resolution of the Quakers in Pennsylvania, to set at liberty all their negro slaves, may satisfy us that their number cannot be very great. Had they made any considerable part of their property, such a resolution could never have been agreed to. In our sugar colonies., on the contrary, the whole work is done by slaves, and in our tobacco colonies a very great part of it. The profits of a sugar plantation in any of our West Indian colonies, are generally much greater than those of any other cultivation that is known either in Europe or America; and the profits of a tobacco plantation, though inferior to those of sugar, are superior to those of corn, as has already been observed. Both can afford the expense of slave cultivation but sugar can afford it still better than tobacco. The number of negroes, accordingly, is much greater, in proportion to that of whites, in our sugar than in our tobacco colonies.
p9.zh: 人的骄傲使他爱上了做家务的人,没有什么能让他受苦受难,以至于不得不谦逊地劝说自己的下等人. 因此,无论法律允许什么,而且工作的性质能够负担得起,他一般都倾向于奴隶服务而不是自由人服务。种植糖和烟草可以支付奴隶种植的费用。玉米的种植似乎在当今时代是不可能的。 在英国殖民地中,主要产物是玉米,其中最大的作品由自由人完成.宾夕法尼亚的贵格会晚期通过决议 释放他们所有的黑人奴隶 可能令我们确信他们的人数并不多 如果他们把相当一部分财产作为自己的财产,那么这样的决议就永远不可能得到同意。 在我们的糖殖民地,相反,整个工作是由奴隶完成的,在我们烟草殖民地中,有很大一部分是奴隶。 在我们西印度殖民地的任何一处糖种植园的利润一般比欧洲或美国已知的任何其他种植的利润大得多;烟草种植园的利润虽然低于糖的利润,但优于玉米的利润,正如已经观察到的那样。两者都能负担起种植奴隶的费用,但糖的价格仍然比烟草高。 因此,在我们糖中,黑人的数量与白人的比例要大得多,而我们的烟草聚居区则要多得多。

p10.original: To the slave cultivators of ancient times gradually succeeded a species of farmers, known at present in France by the name of metayers. They are called in Latin Coloni Partiarii. They have been so long in disuse in England, that at present I know no English name for them. The proprietor furnished them with the seed, cattle, and instruments of husbandry, the whole stock, in short, necessary for cultivating the farm. The produce was divided equally between the proprietor and the farmer, after setting aside what was judged necessary for keeping up the stock, which was restored to the proprietor, when the farmer either quitted or was turned out of the farm.
p10.zh: 向古代的奴隶栽培者逐渐继承了一种农民品种,目前法国以元代人的名字而闻名. 它们被称为拉丁语的科洛尼Partiari(英语:Coloni Partiari). 在英国,他们已经很久没有使用过,所以目前我对他们没有英文名字。业主向他们提供了种子、牛和畜牧工具,简而言之,是农场种植所必需的全部牲畜。农产品在将维持库存所必须的,即农民退耕还耕时或退耕还耕时,被平分,由庄主和农户平分.

p11.original: Land occupied by such tenants is properly cultivated at the expense of the proprietors, as much as that occupied by slaves. There is, however, one very essential difference between them. Such tenants, being freemen, are capable of acquiring property; and having a certain proportion of the produce of the land, they have a plain interest that the whole produce should be as great as possible, in order that their own proportion may be so. A slave, on the contrary, who can acquire nothing but his maintenance, consults his own ease, by making the land produce as little as possible over and above that maintenance. It is probable that it was partly upon account of this advantage, and partly upon account of the encroachments which the sovereigns, always jealous of the great lords, gradually encouraged their villains to make upon their authority, and which seem, at least, to have been such as rendered this species of servitude altogether inconvenient, that tenure in villanage gradually wore out through the greater part of Europe. The time and manner, however, in which so important a revolution was brought about, is one of the most obscure points in modern history. The church of Rome claims great merit in it; and it is certain, that so early as the twelfth century, Alexander III. published a bull for the general emancipation of slaves. It seems, however, to have been rather a pious exhortation, than a law to which exact obedience was required from the faithful. Slavery continued to take place almost universally for several centuries afterwards, till it was gradually abolished by the joint operation of the two interests above mentioned; that of the proprietor on the one hand, and that of the sovereign on the other. A villain, enfranchised, and at the same time allowed to continue in possession of the land, having no stock of his own, could cultivate it only by means of what the landlord advanced to him, and must therefore have been what the French call a metayer.
p11.zh: 这种租户所占用的土地,同奴隶所占用的土地一样,都是以业主为代价而适当耕种的。 然而,它们之间有一个非常重要的区别。 这种租户是自由人,能够取得地产;拥有一定比例的土地产物,他们有明显的利益,即整个产物应该尽可能大,以便他们自己的比例可以这样. 相反,奴隶除了获得他的维持费外,别无他法,而是通过使土地在维持费之外尽可能少地生产,来咨询自己的方便。其部分原因很可能是这一优势,部分原因可能是君主们总是嫉妒大领主,逐渐鼓励他们的反派对他们的权威进行侵犯,这至少似乎使这种奴役变得完全不方便,而别墅的保有权则逐渐通过欧洲大部分地区被耗尽。 然而,革命如此重要的时间和方式是现代史上最模糊的一点。罗马的教堂声称其中有巨大的功绩;而且可以肯定的是,早在12世纪,亚历山大三世就出版了一头公牛,用于奴隶的全面解放. 然而,这似乎是一种虔诚的劝告,而不是要求信徒严格服从的法律。奴隶制在几个世纪之后几乎继续普遍发生,直到上述两个利益集团 -- -- 一方面是所有权人的利益集团,另一方面是主权人的利益集团 -- -- 的联合行动逐渐废除。恶人,被授予土地权利,同时被允许继续占有土地,没有自己的库存,只能靠地主向他推进的东西来耕种,因此,一定是法国人所称的"元人".

p12.original: It could never, however, be the interest even of this last species of cultivators, to lay out, in the further improvement of the land, any part of the little stock which they might save from their own share of the produce; because the landlord, who laid out nothing, was to get one half of whatever it produced. The tithe, which is but a tenth of the produce, is found to be a very great hindrance to improvement. A tax, therefore, which amounted to one half, must have been an effectual bar to it. It might be the interest of a metayer to make the land produce as much as could be brought out of it by means of the stock furnished by the proprietor; but it could never be his interest to mix any part of his own with it. In France, where five parts out of six of the whole kingdom are said to be still occupied by this species of cultivators, the proprietors complain, that their metayers take every opportunity of employing their master's cattle rather in carriage than in cultivation; because, in the one case, they get the whole profits to themselves, in the other they share them with their landlord. This species of tenants still subsists in some parts of Scotland. They are called steel-bow tenants. Those ancient English tenants, who are said by Chief-Baron Gilbert and Dr Blackstone to have been rather bailiffs of the landlord than farmers, properly so called, were probably of the same kind.
p12.zh: 然而,即使这些最后一种种植者的利益也决不是进一步改良土地,他们可能从自己所占的农产品份额中省去的小股票的任何一部分;因为没有铺设的地主要得到它所生产的东西的一半。十分之一的,只是产量的十分之一,被认为是改进的一大障碍。 因此,相当于一半的税收必须是对其有效的限制。使土地产量尽可能地通过业主提供的股票运出,这也许是一位元老的利益;但是,他从来就没有兴趣将自己的任何部分与它混为一谈。 在法国,据说整个王国的六分之五仍然被这种种种的种植者占据,庄主抱怨说,他们的牧人利用一切机会,雇用主人的牛而不是耕种;因为,在一种情况下,他们得到全部利润,在另一种情况下,他们与地主分享这些利润。 这种租户在苏格兰的一些地区仍然生存着. 他们被称为钢牛房客。 那些古老的英国房客,被首席巴伦·吉尔伯特和布莱克斯通博士说成是地主的法警而不是农民,他们被适当称为是同类的.

p13.original: To this species of tenantry succeeded, though by very slow degrees, farmers, properly so called, who cultivated the land with their own stock, paying a rent certain to the landlord. When such farmers have a lease for a term of years, they may sometimes find it for their interest to lay out part of their capital in the further improvement of the farm; because they may sometimes expect to recover it, with a large profit, before the expiration of the lease. The possession, even of such farmers, however, was long extremely precarious, and still is so in many parts of Europe. They could, before the expiration of their term, be legally ousted of their leases by a new purchaser; in England, even, by the fictitious action of a common recovery. If they were turned out illegally by the violence of their master, the action by which they obtained redress was extremely imperfect. It did not always reinstate them in the possession of the land, but gave them damages, which never amounted to a real loss. Even in England, the country, perhaps of Europe, where the yeomanry has always been most respected, it was not till about the 14th of Henry VII. that the action of ejectment was invented, by which the tenant recovers, not damages only, but possession, and in which his claim is not necessarily concluded by the uncertain decision of a single assize. This action has been found so effectual a remedy, that, in the modern practice, when the landlord has occasion to sue for the possession of the land, he seldom makes use of the actions which properly belong to him as a landlord, the writ of right or the writ of entry, but sues in the name of his tenant, by the writ of ejectment. In England, therefore the security of the tenant is equal to that of the proprietor. In England, besides, a lease for life of forty shillings a-year value is a freehold, and entitles the lessee to a vote for a member of parliament; and as a great part of the yeomanry have freeholds of this kind, the whole order becomes respectable to their landlords, on account of the political consideration which this gives them. There is, I believe, nowhere in Europe, except in England, any instance of the tenant building upon the land of which he had no lease, and trusting that the honour of his landlord would take no advantage of so important an improvement. Those laws and customs, so favourable to the yeomanry, have perhaps contributed more to the present grandeur of England, than all their boasted regulations of commerce taken together.
p13.zh: 这种租户制取得了成功,虽然程度非常缓慢,但农民,也就是所谓的农民,用自己的股权耕种土地,向地主支付一定的租金。 当这种农民有为期数年的租约时,他们有时可能为了自己的利益而发现在进一步改进农场时拿出一部分资本;因为他们有时可能在租约到期前期望收回这笔资本,并获得巨额利润。 然而,即使这些农民拥有这些土地,也长期极为不稳定,而且在欧洲许多地方仍然如此。 在他们期满之前,他们可能在法律上被一个新的购买者取消租约;甚至在英国,通过共同收回的虚构行动。 如果她们被主人的暴力非法杀害,她们获得补救的行动就极不完美。 它并不总是恢复他们的土地,而是给予他们损害,这从未构成真正的损失。即使在英格兰,这个国家,也许是欧洲,耶奥曼里一直受到最尊重,直到大约亨利七世的十四世时,喷射行动才被发明出来,通过喷射行动,租户不仅收回损失,而且收回财产,在这种行动中,他的主张不一定以单一的大小的不确定决定而告终. 这一行动被认为非常有效,在现代实践中,当地主有机会起诉拥有土地时,他很少利用作为地主理应属于他的行为、权利令状或入境令状,而是以房客的名义,通过驱逐令状起诉。 因此,在英国,租户的担保与房主的担保相等. 此外,在英国,年价值40先令的终身租约是一种自由持有权,承租人有权投票选举一名议员;而且,作为主要部分的贵族拥有这种自由持有权,整个命令因其给予他们的政治考虑而变得可以受到房东的尊重。 我认为,在欧洲,除了英国,没有任何地方存在任何租户在他没有租约的土地上建造房屋的事例,并且相信房东的荣誉不会利用如此重要的改善。这些法律和习俗,如此有利于优雅的贵族,也许对英国现在的伟大者的贡献比他们吹嘘的通商条例加在一起要大。

p14.original: The law which secures the longest leases against successors of every kind, is, so far as I know, peculiar to Great Britain. It was introduced into Scotland so early as 1449, by a law of James II. Its beneficial influence, however, has been much obstructed by entails; the heirs of entail being generally restrained from letting leases for any long term of years, frequently for more than one year. A late act of parliament has, in this respect, somewhat slackened their fetters, though they are still by much too strait. In Scotland, besides, as no leasehold gives a vote for a member of parliament, the yeomanry are upon this account less respectable to their landlords than in England.
p14.zh: 我所知道的法律 保证最长的租赁 与各种继承人 , 就我所知, 是英国的特有。 它早在1449年就被詹姆斯二世的一部法律引入苏格兰. 然而,其有利影响受到各种因素的阻碍;这些因素的继承人一般都受到限制,不能让租期长,往往超过一年。 在这方面,议会的迟到行动在一定程度上放松了脚镣,尽管脚镣仍然过于紧凑。 此外,在苏格兰,由于没有租借权给予议员投票权,因此,与英格兰相比,青年对房东的尊敬程度较低。

p15.original: In other parts of Europe, after it was found convenient to secure tenants both against heirs and purchasers, the term of their security was still limited to a very short period; in France, for example, to nine years from the commencement of the lease. It has in that country, indeed, been lately extended to twentyseven, a period still too short to encourage the tenant to make the most important improvements. The proprietors of land were anciently the legislators of every part of Europe. The laws relating to land, therefore, were all calculated for what they supposed the interest of the proprietor. It was for his interest, they had imagined, that no lease granted by any of his predecessors should hinder him from enjoying, during a long term of years, the full value of his land. Avarice and injustice are always short-sighted, and they did not foresee how much this regulation must obstruct improvement, and thereby hurt, in the long-run, the real interest of the landlord.
p15.zh: 在欧洲其他地区,在发现方便地向承租人和购买人提供担保之后,他们的担保期限仍然被限制在很短的时间内;例如,在法国,从租赁开始到9年。 事实上,最近在该国,这一期限已延长到27年,仍然太短,无法鼓励租户作出最重要的改进。土地的拥有者是古代欧洲各地的立法者。 因此,与土地有关的法律都是按他们所认为的业主的利益来计算的。 他们以为,为了他的利益,他的前任授予的任何租约都不应妨碍他在多年的时间里享有其土地的全部价值。贪婪和不公正总是短视的,他们没有预见到这一条例必须阻碍改进的程度,从而长期损害地主的真正利益。

p16.original: The farmers, too, besides paying the rent, were anciently, it was supposed, bound to perform a great number of services to the landlord, which were seldom either specified in the lease, or regulated by any precise rule, but by the use and wont of the manor or barony. These services, therefore, being almost entirely arbitrary, subjected the tenant to many vexations. In Scotland the abolition of all services not precisely stipulated in the lease, has, in the course of a few years, very much altered for the better the condition of the yeomanry of that country.
p16.zh: 农民除了付房租之外,在古代也理应向房东提供大量服务,这些服务很少在租约中规定,也很少受到任何确切规则的管制,而是受到庄园或庄园的使用和支配。 因此,这些服务几乎完全是任意性的,使租户受到许多抱怨。 在苏格兰,废除了租约中未明确规定的所有服务,在几年中,为了改善该国优柔寡断的状况,情况发生了很大变化。

p17.original: The public services to which the yeomanry were bound, were not less arbitrary than the private ones. To make and maintain the high roads, a servitude which still subsists, I believe, everywhere, though with different degrees of oppression in different countries, was not the only one. When the king's troops, when his household, or his officers of any kind, passed through any part of the country, the yeomanry were bound to provide them with horses, carriages, and provisions, at a price regulated by the purveyor. Great Britain is, I believe, the only monarchy in Europe where the oppression of purveyance has been entirely abolished. It still subsists in France and Germany.
p17.zh: 与私人服务相比,青年必须接受的公共服务不亚于任意性。 我认为,尽管在不同国家受到不同程度的压迫,但各地仍然存在着一种奴役。 当国王的军队,当他的家庭,或任何种类的军官经过任何地区时,耶奥曼利人必然要给他们提供马匹,马车,和各种供给,价格由普罗维耶人规定. 我认为,大不列颠是欧洲唯一一个完全废除了对纯洁主义的压迫的君主制国家。 它仍然在法国和德国生存。

p18.original: The public taxes, to which they were subject, were as irregular and oppressive as the services. The ancient lords, though extremely unwilling to grant, themselves, any pecuniary aid to their sovereign, easily allowed him to tallage, as they called it, their tenants, and had not knowledge enough to foresee how much this must, in the end, affect their own revenue. The taille, as it still subsists in France may serve as an example of those ancient tallages. It is a tax upon the supposed profits of the farmer, which they estimate by the stock that he has upon the farm. It is his interest, therefore, to appear to have as little as possible, and consequently to employ as little as possible in its cultivation, and none in its improvement. Should any stock happen to accumulate in the hands of a French farmer, the taille is almost equal to a prohibition of its ever being employed upon the land. This tax, besides, is supposed to dishonour whoever is subject to it, and to degrade him below, not only the rank of a gentleman, but that of a burgher; and whoever rents the lands of another becomes subject to it. No gentleman, nor even any burgher, who has stock, will submit to this degradation. This tax, therefore, not only hinders the stock which accumulates upon the land from being employed in its improvement, but drives away all other stock from it. The ancient tenths and fifteenths, so usual in England in former times, seem, so far as they affected the land, to have been taxes of the same nature with the taille.
p18.zh: 公共税与服务一样不规则和压迫性。古代的领主,虽然极其不愿意给自己任何金钱援助给自己的君主,却轻易地让他统计,就像他们所说的,他们的房客,并且没有足够的知识来预见这最终会给自己的收入带来多大的影响.尾巴在法国仍然存在,可以作为这些古老的计数的例子。 这是对农民的预期利润的征税,他们按农民在农场的股票估算。 因此,他的兴趣是尽量少地种植,从而尽量少地种植,而没有任何改进。 如果在法国农民的手中积累了任何种群,尾巴几乎等于禁止其永远在土地上就业。况此税,必使受此税之人,失其名誉,贬其下,不惟君子之阶,而为堡垒之阶;凡租他人之地者,必受其服.任何绅士,甚至任何拥有股票的堡垒,都不会屈服于这种退化. 因此,这种税收不仅妨碍在土地上积累的牲畜在改良中就业,而且还驱赶了所有其他牲畜。古代的第十和十五代,在以前英格兰如此常见,似乎,就影响土地而言,与尾巴一样,都是性质相同的税.

p19.original: Under all these discouragements, little improvement could be expected from the occupiers of land. That order of people, with all the liberty and security which law can give, must always improve under great disadvantage. The farmer, compared with the proprietor, is as a merchant who trades with burrowed money, compared with one who trades with his own. The stock of both may improve; but that of the one, with only equal good conduct, must always improve more slowly than that of the other, on account of the large share of the profits which is consumed by the interest of the loan. The lands cultivated by the farmer must, in the same manner, with only equal good conduct, be improved more slowly than those cultivated by the proprietor, on account of the large share of the produce which is consumed in the rent, and which, had the farmer been proprietor, he might have employed in the further improvement of the land. The station of a farmer, besides, is, from the nature of things, inferior to that of a proprietor. Through the greater part of Europe, the yeomanry are regarded as an inferior rank of people, even to the better sort of tradesmen and mechanics, and in all parts of Europe to the great merchants and master manufacturers. It can seldom happen, therefore, that a man of any considerable stock should quit the superior, in order to place himself in an inferior station. Even in the present state of Europe, therefore, little stock is likely to go from any other profession to the improvement of land in the way of farming. More does, perhaps, in Great Britain than in any other country, though even there the great stocks which are in some places employed in farming, have generally been acquired by fanning, the trade, perhaps, in which, of all others, stock is commonly acquired most slowly. After small proprietors, however, rich and great farmers are in every country the principal improvers. There are more such, perhaps, in England than in any other European monarchy. In the republican governments of Holland, and of Berne in Switzerland, the farmers are said to be not inferior to those of England.
p19.zh: 在所有这些劝阻下,对土地的占领者几乎没有什么改善。人民秩序,以及法律能够给予的一切自由和安全,必须永远在极其不利的条件下得到改善。与庄主相比,农夫作为商人,以埋藏的金钱进行交易,与自己从事交易的商人相比.两者的存量都可能改善;但是,由于贷款利息所消耗的利润份额很大,两者的存量,其表现相同,但必须总是比后者慢得多。农民耕种的土地,必须同样地,品行相同,比业主耕种的土地要慢得多,因为租金中消耗的农产品占很大比例,如果农民是业主,他可能雇用这些土地来进一步改善土地。 此外,从事物的本质来看,农民的地位低于业主的地位。 通过欧洲的大部分地区,耶奥曼里人被视为人的低等阶层,甚至被看作更好的商人和机械师,在欧洲各地,被看作伟大的商人和主制造商. 因此,一个拥有大量财富的人很少会辞职,以便把自己安置在低级岗位上。 因此,即使在目前欧洲国家,也不可能有太多的牲畜从任何其他职业转向以耕作方式改善土地。 在大不列颠,或许比在任何其他国家做更多的事情,尽管即使在有些地方从事农业的大股票一般都是靠扇子收购的,而贸易,也许,在所有其他贸易中,股票通常最缓慢地收购。 然而,在小业主之后,富国和伟大的农民在每个国家是主要的改良者。 也许,在英国,这种统治比其他欧洲君主制统治更为严重。 在荷兰的共和政府,瑞士的伯尔尼的共和政府中,农民据说并不逊于英格兰的农民.

p20.original: The ancient policy of Europe was, over and above all this, unfavourable to the improvement and cultivation of land, whether carried on by the proprietor or by the farmer; first, by the general prohibition of the exportation of corn, without a special licence, which seems to have been a very universal regulation; and, secondly, by the restraints which were laid upon the inland commerce, not only of corn, but of almost every other part of the produce of the farm, by the absurd laws against engrossers, regraters, and forestallers, and by the privileges of fairs and markets. It has already been observed in what manner the prohibition of the exportation of corn, together with some encouragement given to the importation of foreign corn, obstructed the cultivation of ancient Italy, naturally the most fertile country in Europe, and at that time the seat of the greatest empire in the world. To what degree such restraints upon the inland commerce of this commodity, joined to the general prohibition of exportation, must have discouraged the cultivation of countries less fertile, and less favourably circumstanced, it is not, perhaps, very easy to imagine.
p20.zh: 欧洲的古老政策首先不利于土地的改善和耕种,无论是由业主还是农民所为;首先,普遍禁止出口玉米,没有特别许可证,这似乎是一项非常普遍的规定;其次,不仅对玉米,而且对农场几乎所有其他部分的农产品实行限制,对收割者、放牧者和阻止者实行荒谬的法律,以及集市和市场的特权。 人们已经注意到,禁止出口玉米,以及鼓励进口外国玉米,是如何阻碍古意大利的种植的,古意大利自然是欧洲最肥沃的国家,当时是世界最大帝国的所在地。 这种限制这种商品的内陆商业,加上普遍禁止出口,在什么程度上必然阻止了肥力较弱和条件较差的国家的种植,也许很难想象。
